title.zh-TW: 營養午餐餿了，只有小明沒中毒
title.en: Spoiled school lunch: only Xiaoming stays well

subtitle.zh-TW: 問「為什麼同學中毒」與問「為什麼小明沒事」，兩個答案取決於不同的預設值（default）。
subtitle.en: The same event, asked two ways: why the classmates fell ill, and why Xiaoming did not.

story.zh-TW: 考慮學校午餐的情境。學生平常都吃學校供應的營養午餐。某天午餐餿掉了，吃了午餐的同學集體食物中毒，只有自己帶便當的小明沒有任何症狀。
story.en: Consider a school whose pupils normally all eat the lunch the school provides. One day the lunch has spoiled, and the classmates who ate it all fall ill with food poisoning. Only Xiaoming, who brought his own lunch box, has no symptoms.

zh-TW.sentence: 某天午餐餿掉了，吃了午餐的同學集體食物中毒，
只有自己帶便當的小明沒有任何症狀。

en.sentence: One day the lunch has spoiled, and the classmates who ate it all fall ill with food poisoning.
Only Xiaoming, who brought his own lunch box, has no symptoms.

text.zh-TW: 同學中毒的原因是午餐餿了，吃營養午餐不算原因。
text.en: Asked why the classmates fell ill, people answer that the lunch spoiled, not that they ate the school lunch.

explanation.zh-TW: 同學吃午餐（LUNCH_C），小明不吃（LUNCH_M），午餐餿了（SPOIL）。吃了餿午餐就中毒（ILL_C = LUNCH_C·SPOIL，ILL_M = LUNCH_M·SPOIL）。問同學為什麼中毒，依食品衛生規範，午餐不餿、人不中毒是預設值（default），全校吃午餐也是預設。問小明為什麼沒事，其他人都中毒了，所以 ILL_M 的預設為 1。引擎一個模型只有一組預設，所以兩人拆成不同變數，讓兩組預設並存（王鵬翔 2019）。
explanation.en: The model puts both questions in one world: the classmates eat the lunch (LUNCH_C), Xiaoming does not (LUNCH_M), the lunch has spoiled (SPOIL), and eating the spoiled lunch makes one ill (ILL_C = LUNCH_C·SPOIL, ILL_M = LUNCH_M·SPOIL). The simple counterfactual test says, for both questions, that eating the lunch is a cause: without it no one would be ill. The difference lies in what the question takes as the default (Wang 2019). Asked why the classmates fell ill, the relevant norm is food hygiene: lunch should be clean and people healthy (SPOIL = 0, ILL_C = 0), while eating the school lunch is the school-wide routine (LUNCH_C = 1), so only the spoilage is a departure. Asked why Xiaoming stayed well, what needs explaining is the unexpected good health, since everyone else fell ill (the default for ILL_M is 1), and Xiaoming's lunch box departs from the school-wide routine, so eating his own lunch is the cause. The two questions use opposite defaults, which is the point of the case: a default is not an intrinsic property of an event. The engine holds one set of defaults per model, so the two people are given separate variables and both sets of defaults coexist.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2019). The problems of counterfactual thinking in omissive causal judgements [in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 49(3), 287–340.

note.zh-TW: 〈食物中毒〉在第 318 頁，兩種提問與對應的規範也在同頁。第 326–327 頁另以防止食物中毒為例談干預手段。
note.en: The food-poisoning case and its two questions, with the norm each one invokes, are on p. 318; pp. 326–327 return to it when discussing how to prevent the poisoning.

verdicts.note: Witness: LUNCH_C = 0 departs from the school-wide routine.
The question about Xiaoming takes his good health as the departure (default ILL_M = 1).

label.en: Xiaoming eats the school lunch too
